claims.boundary: Exact homogeneous-bend TME conditions do not prove a practical matched MBA.
The reported compromise is not a universal factor for every lattice.

The transferable architecture is two outer DBA-like chromatic regions around three central TME-like regions. ESRF and HEPS numerical phases, gradients, lengths, and bump heights are evidence, not fixed defaults.

For N positive bends, Brilliance validates interior maxima over B1-B2 and B(N-1)-BN plus a separate low-dispersion envelope across B3-B(N-2). Bend count, one local element edit, or two point samples do not establish this architecture.
Benefits depend on optics, focusing, field limits, and the complete matched ring; reverse-bend presence alone is not an improvement.
Brilliance has no reviewed JuTrack LGB model. This claim is background knowledge and supplies no construction or numerical authority.
HEPS values are not reused without an explicit licensed reference lattice, and its LGB implementation is not executable in the current JuTrack route.

APS-U demonstrates that reverse fields can change energy loss, damping partition, insertion optics, and sextupole dispersion together. Brilliance must evaluate all of those effects on its own complete matched ring; replacing quadrupoles by anti-bends is not a universal recipe.

SLS 2.0 demonstrates a compact LGB/reverse-bend solution under an existing-tunnel and hardware constraint. Since Brilliance currently defers LGB modeling, this is architecture knowledge only and supplies no executable approximation.

SAPS demonstrates co-optimization of hybrid roles, reverse bends, damping time, dispersion leverage, phase relations, dynamic aperture, and momentum acceptance. Its numerical layout is not a Brilliance seed, and unsupported longitudinal gradients remain non-executable.

Published machines define transferable roles, coupled observables, and evidence gates. Construction must start from the accepted project lattice and scientist constraints, never from copied facility numbers.
The module records invalid and infeasible candidates separately.
PSO supplies proposals; nondominated sorting and crowding perform environmental selection.
